title: Exact inference from finite market data
title_zh: 有限市场数据的精确推断
authors: F. Kübler, R. Malhotra, H. Polemarchakis
abstract: We derive conditions for individual choices and $$ \epsilon $$ ϵ -equilibrium prices to be inferred from a finite set of market data in the following sense: Although potential observations are infinite, inference can be attained and known to have been attained after a finite number of observations. While we first examine the case of observations on an individual’s demand at different prices and incomes, our primary focus is on equilibrium, where only profiles of individual endowments and associated equilibrium prices are observable. Our main result is that finite inference is possible in the equilibrium setting if one wants to infer either individual choices or the $$ \epsilon $$ ϵ -equilibrium correspondence.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文推导了从有限市场数据推断个体选择与ε-均衡价格的条件，其含义如下：尽管潜在观测数据是无限的，但经过有限次观测后，推断不仅能够实现，且可被确认为已完成。我们首先考察了不同价格与收入水平下个体需求观测的情形，但主要关注均衡状态——此时仅能观测到个体禀赋组合及其对应的均衡价格。核心结论是：若需推断个体选择或ε-均衡对应关系，则在均衡框架下有限次推断是可行的。

title: Persuasion with Coarse Communication
title_zh: 粗沟通中的说服
authors: Yunus C. Aybas, Eray Turkel
abstract: In many expert–decision maker settings, information is richer than the language used to convey it. Motivated by this communication friction, we study Bayesian persuasion when the sender is constrained to use k messages. We show that the sender’s value is given by a k -point analogue of concavification, which we call k -concavification. An optimal information structure can be chosen with affinely independent posterior support, allowing the problem to be reduced to a lower-dimensional persuasion problem and then solved by standard concavification. We derive a tight bound on the value of communication capacity that applies to general persuasion games: the gain from a $$(k+1)$$ ( k + 1 ) st message is at most $$2/(k-1)$$ 2 / ( k - 1 ) times the value attainable with k messages. Finally, we solve a class of belief-threshold games in which the receiver chooses between a safe default and several risky actions, the sender gets zero from the default and the same positive payoff from any risky action, and a risky action is taken only when the corresponding posterior probability exceeds a threshold. We characterize the optimal coarse information structure, derive comparative statics in the prior and the threshold, and extend the analysis to heterogeneous thresholds and heterogeneous sender values across risky actions.
abstract_zh: 摘要 在许多专家与决策者互动的场景中，信息本身比用于传递信息的语言更为丰富。受这种沟通摩擦的启发，我们研究了当发送者被限制使用k条消息时的贝叶斯说服问题。我们证明，发送者的价值由凹化概念的k点对应物给出，我们称之为k-凹化。最优信息结构可以选择具有仿射独立后验支撑的形式，从而将问题简化为低维说服问题，并通过标准凹化方法求解。我们推导了适用于一般说服博弈的沟通容量价值的紧界：第(k+1)条消息带来的增益最多为k条消息可实现价值的2/(k-1)倍。最后，我们求解了一类信念阈值博弈，其中接收者在安全默认选项与多个风险行动之间进行选择，发送者从默认选项中获得零收益，从任何风险行动中获得相同的正收益，且仅当相应的后验概率超过阈值时才采取风险行动。我们刻画了最优粗糙信息结构，推导了关于先验和阈值的比较静态分析，并将分析扩展至风险行动具有异质性阈值和异质性发送者价值的情形。

title: A Static Capital Buffer is Hard To Beat
title_zh: 静态资本缓冲难以被超越
authors: Matthew Canzoneri, Behzad Diba, Luca Guerrieri, Arsenii Mishin
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: In a model with endogenous risk-taking, deposit insurance and limited liability may lead banks to make risky loans that are socially inefficient. Capital requirements can prevent excessive risk-taking at the cost of reducing liquidity-producing bank deposits. A policy that sets capital requirements just high enough to prevent excessive risktaking will move capital requirements pro-, counter-, or a-cyclically depending on the shock source. However, such a policy requires full knowledge of all the shocks hitting the economy and is not implementable. Simple rules that respond to cyclical conditions—in line with Basel III guidance—perform poorly, whereas a small static capital buffer can do much better.
abstract_zh: 在内生风险承担模型中，存款保险与有限责任可能导致银行发放社会效率低下的高风险贷款。资本充足要求能够以降低流动性创造型银行存款为代价，防止过度风险承担。若将资本充足要求设定为恰好足以遏制过度风险承担的水平，该政策将根据冲击来源呈现顺周期、逆周期或非周期特征。然而，此类政策要求完全掌握冲击经济的全部因素，实际中并不可行。符合《巴塞尔协议III》指引的周期性调节型简单规则表现欠佳，而小规模静态资本缓冲却能取得显著更优效果。

title: Beliefs About the Economy are Excessively Sensitive to Household-Level Shocks: Evidence from Linked Survey and Administrative Data
title_zh: 家庭层面冲击对经济信念的过度敏感：基于关联调查与行政数据的证据
authors: Dmitry Taubinsky, Luigi Butera, Matteo Saccarola, Chen Lian
abstract: We study how people’s beliefs about the economy covary with household-level events, utilizing a unique link between Danish administrative data and a large-scale survey of consumer expectations. We find that compared to actual inflation, people’s inflation forecasts covary much more strongly (and negatively) with both recently realized household income changes and measures of expected future household income changes. We formally establish that these findings are stark deviations from the Bayesian rational expectations benchmark. Similar results hold for perceptions of past inflation (“backcasts” ), suggesting that imperfect recall is a key mechanism for biased forecasts. Building on this, a series of additional tests, some of which utilize data on adverse health events, suggests that the forecast biases are at least partly due to affect-cued recall. That is, negative (positive) household-level events cue negative (positive) recollections, which lead to pessimistic (optimistic) forecasts.
abstract_zh: 我们利用丹麦行政数据与大规模消费者预期调查之间的独特关联，研究了人们对经济的信念如何随家庭层面事件而变化。研究发现，相较于实际通胀率，人们的通胀预测与近期已实现的家庭收入变化以及预期的未来家庭收入变化指标之间存在显著更强的负向协动关系。我们正式证明，这些发现与贝叶斯理性预期基准存在显著偏离。类似结果也适用于对过去通胀的感知（"回溯预测"），表明不完美回忆是导致预测偏差的关键机制。在此基础上，一系列附加检验（部分利用不良健康事件数据）表明，预测偏差至少部分源于情感线索回忆——即负面（正面）家庭层面事件会触发负面（正面）回忆，进而导致悲观（乐观）预测。

title: The Causal Effects of Confidence Awareness on Financial Literacy and Behaviour
title_zh: 信心意识对金融素养与行为的因果效应
authors: Ines Lee, Ana Lleó-Bono, Christopher Rauh, Eileen Tipoe
official: 官方在线 2025-10-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines whether increasing individuals’ awareness of their own confidence can influence financial behaviour. In a pre-registered online experiment with nearly 3,000 U.S. adults, we test the effects of a novel metacognitive intervention: personalised feedback on implicit confidence about one’s financial abilities, as measured by a custom Implicit Association Test (IAT), paired with an explanation of the importance of self-confidence in financial abilities. Treated participants show a significant reduction in “don’t know” responses on financial literacy tests and their performance in an incentivised investment task significantly improves: treated participants are less likely to make clearly dominated choices, more likely to select efficient allocations, and choose portfolios closer to the efficient frontier. These effects persist two weeks later in a follow-up survey with obfuscated framing. Heterogeneity analyses show stronger effects for females and for participants who understate their confidence (i.e. whose reported confidence is lower than what their IAT suggests). Keywords: Confidence, Confidence awareness, Personal finance, Financial literacy, Survey experiment.
abstract_zh: 本文探究提升个体对自身信心的认知是否会影响其金融行为。在一项针对近3000名美国成年人的预注册在线实验中，我们测试了一种新型元认知干预措施的效果：通过定制化内隐联想测验（IAT）测量个体对自身金融能力的内隐信心，并辅以关于金融能力自信心重要性的解释，向参与者提供个性化反馈。接受干预的参与者在金融素养测试中回答“不知道”的比例显著降低，且其在激励性投资任务中的表现显著改善：他们更少做出明显被支配的选择，更倾向于选择有效配置方案，并选择更接近有效前沿的投资组合。这些效应在两周后以模糊化框架进行的追踪调查中依然持续存在。异质性分析显示，该效应在女性参与者以及低估自身信心（即自我报告信心低于IAT测量结果）的参与者中更为显著。关键词：信心，信心认知，个人理财，金融素养，调查实验。
